connect_pybullet_direct: connect to the pybullet physics simulator in DIRECT mode for headless rendering
load_urdf_models: load URDF robot models like r2d2.urdf into the pybullet simulation environment
compute_view_matrix: compute a camera view matrix from yaw, pitch, and roll angles for rendering
compute_projection_matrix: compute a perspective projection matrix using field of view and aspect ratio
get_camera_image: render a camera image with RGB and depth data using OpenGL hardware rendering
